mapper.update: UPDATE user_coupon SET status = 'USED', order_id = #{orderId}, used_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'UNUSED'
UPDATE user_coupon SET status = 'UNUSED', order_id = NULL, used_time = NULL WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'USED'
mapper.select: SELECT uc.id, uc.coupon_id AS couponId, c.name, c.type, c.threshold, c.discount_amount AS discountAmount, c.discount_percent AS discountPercent, c.max_discount_amount AS maxDiscountAmount, uc.status, uc.order_id AS orderId, uc.receive_time AS receiveTime, uc.valid_start_time AS validStartTime, uc.valid_end_time AS validEndTime, uc.used_time AS usedTime FROM user_coupon uc INNER JOIN coupon c ON c.id = uc.coupon_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY uc.status ASC, uc.receive_time DESC
